concept.description: Folds the artifact nodes that share a Maven coordinate into a single node, keeping the copy that carries the classes and redirecting every relationship of the others onto it.

constraint.description: No Maven coordinate may be represented by more than one artifact node. Guards the concept above: a coordinate that still has several nodes means the merge did not reach it.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (a:Maven:Artifact) WITH a.fqn AS coordinate, count(a) AS nodes, collect(a.fileName) AS files WHERE nodes > 1 RETURN coordinate, nodes, files ORDER BY nodes DESC, coordinate
